spans.s:
(ऋ) कबृ r. 1st cl. (कबते)
1 To colour, to tinge with various hues.
2 To praise.

mn. (-न्धः-न्धं)
A headless trunk, especially retaining vitality.
n. (-न्धं)
Water.
m. (-न्धः)
1 A name of
Also of a demon destroyed by

The belly.
E.
कं the head, and बध to injure, to lop, affix अच्; also कं water, and बन्ध binding, attaching.

f. (-ता)
Headlessness, decapitation.
E.
कबन्ध and तल् affix; also with त्व, कबन्धत्व.

m. (-त्थः)
The elephant or wood apple: see कपित्थ.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Tawny, (of such a hue.)
m. (-लः)
Tawny, (the colour): see कपिल.
